title: Exchange Seats
statement_md:
Write a solution to swap the seat id of every two consecutive students. If the number of students is odd, the id of the last student is not swapped.

Return the result table ordered by `id` in **ascending order**.

Table: `Seat` (`id INT PRIMARY KEY, student VARCHAR(255)`)
constraints: id is an autoincrement column starting from 1.

input.schema: CREATE TABLE Seat (id INT PRIMARY KEY, student VARCHAR(255)); INSERT INTO Seat VALUES (1, "Abbot"), (2, "Doris"), (3, "Emerson"), (4, "Green"), (5, "Jeames");
input.query: SELECT CASE WHEN id % 2 = 1 AND id = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Seat) THEN id WHEN id % 2 = 1 THEN id + 1 ELSE id - 1 END AS id, student FROM Seat ORDER BY id;

starter_code.sql:
-- Write your SQL query here
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN id % 2 = 1 AND id = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Seat) THEN id 
    WHEN id % 2 = 1 THEN id + 1 
    ELSE id - 1 
  END AS id, 
  student 
FROM Seat 
ORDER BY id;
